items.name: Scope matches request
items.note: In-page #fragment links in the SmartViewer HTML preview scroll inside the frame instead of opening a new tab (base target=_blank); external links unchanged.

items.name: No dead code / debug
items.note: One helper module (htmlAnchorNav.ts), a one-line splice in buildHtmlSrcDoc, a comment; no leftovers.

items.name: Error/edge paths
items.note: id wins over top fallback, name= anchors, percent-decoding, dead fragment swallowed, modified/non-primary clicks and already-prevented clicks left alone; known limits (SPA #! routes, svg xlink:href, shadow DOM) noted by code review.

items.name: Tests
items.note: 7 jsdom unit tests of the injected script + srcdoc ordering/doctype; E2E smartviewer-html-anchor-nav.spec.ts (scrolls, no popup; external link still opens one) passes with the fix and FAILS without it (negative control). Full vitest 5172 pass.

items.name: Conventions / file size
items.note: htmlAnchorNav.ts ~30 lines, HtmlRenderer.tsx ~157; no bloat entry touched.

items.name: Security / data
items.note: Sandbox (allow-scripts allow-popups..., no allow-same-origin) and CSP unchanged; the script is a static string running in the opaque-origin frame, inline scripts were already allowed.

items.name: Affected boundaries
items.note: srcdoc built for both inline pane and pop-out modal via the same buildHtmlSrcDoc; doctype stays first.
